plan.title: Import plan
plan.instructions: Download these instructions and give the file to your AI along with your goals, available equipment and weekly schedule. Ask it to return an Overload plan file, then load it here.
plan.additive: This adds a new program. Your existing routines, history and settings stay intact.
plan.alreadyImported: This program is already in your routines
plan.unknownExercise: Exercise not found: {{exercise}}. Choose the correct exercise below.
plan.invalid: The plan has an invalid or missing value at {{field}}. Ask the AI to correct it using the downloaded instructions.
plan.readError: Could not read the plan or load the exercise library. Check your connection and choose a JSON or text file smaller than 2 MB.
plan.saveError: Could not save the program. You can retry; existing workouts are safe.

food.coverageHint: A dash means no data. Partial values include only foods with that nutrient recorded. Missing values are never counted as zero.
food.manualHint: Enter only totals not already included in your foods. These appear as a separate manual entry.
food.existingTotals: Your previous totals are preserved. Foods you add will be counted in addition to them.
food.saveMealHint: Save these foods together to add the same meal another day.
food.saveError: Could not save. Your previous entries are safe; try again.
food.quantityError: Enter a quantity greater than zero.
food.deleteHint: Remove this food from this day? Your other entries stay unchanged.
food.entryMissing: This entry is no longer in your diary. Go back to choose another.
food.noResults: No foods found. Try a broader name, a barcode or create a food from its label.
food.noRecent: Foods you log will appear here for quick reuse.
food.noSaved: Save a meal from your diary to find it here.
food.catalogError: Could not load the food database. Connect and try again; recent foods still work offline.
food.cameraHint: Point the camera at the product barcode.
food.cameraError: Camera scanning is unavailable. Close this panel and enter the barcode number instead.
food.barcodeMissing: Product not found. Create a food using the nutrition label.
food.barcodeError: Could not read this product. Check the barcode and connection, or enter its label manually.
food.customHint: Copy the values per 100 g or 100 ml from the label. Leave unknown nutrients blank.
food.customError: Enter a name and at least one nutrient from the label.
food.importHint: Import a JSON or CSV file in the Overload format. Check foods, dates and quantities before adding them.
food.importAdditive: These foods will be added to the listed days. Existing entries stay intact. Importing the same file again does not duplicate them.
food.importUnknown: Food not found: {{food}}. Use a valid catalog ID or include the food’s name, basis and nutrition values in the JSON file.
food.importInvalid: Check {{field}}. Use the downloaded format with valid dates and positive quantities.
food.importReadError: Could not read the file. Choose a JSON or CSV file smaller than 2 MB.
food.removeSavedMealHint: Remove this saved meal? Foods already logged in your diary will stay unchanged.
food.removeSavedMealError: Could not remove the saved meal. Try again.
